- Initial release of the "welding-basics" skill for guided, hands-on metal fabrication and repair.
- Agent-driven workflow: takes care of all planning, research, session tracking, safety checklists, and documentation.
- Human focuses strictly on physical welding—agent customizes training and supports every step from workspace setup to project completion.
- Includes robust intake, equipment recommendations based on real-world constraints, step-by-step practice plans, and maintenance protocols.
- Adapts to crisis or resource-scarce scenarios; enables full DIY fabrication and repair without prior welding knowledge.
- Provides ready-to-use templates (questionnaires, troubleshooting trees, safety checklists, and project logs).
